units: metres; glTF +Y up; floor at y=0
tris_note: scene only; robot is the runtime model (~39k) -> ~63k with robot, budget 100k
size_note: ~5 MB, mostly the embedded s01_window_city.png matte; compress to KTX2/WebP in the build step

backdrop.note: shadeless card behind the window at 120 m, scale 0.556, tower at frame x 0.50, horizon at frame y 0.70; unlit, exclude from fog

camera_hero.dof: Blender review only: focus 8.6 m, f/1.4

robot.pose: hero: leaning 15 deg, reaching arm toward the camera with the open hand palm-out (fingers fanned 28 deg, thumb up), left arm out to the side with the hand open
robot.runtime_note: robot = runtime model; Muse ruled the hand pose a runtime/code item. S01_hero_v2.py ROBOT holds the exact joint quaternions as reference. Rig quirks found here: forearm shell runs 0.15 m past Wrist_*, and finger meshes float ~0.45 m off their joint empties - fixed only in this blend; fix in the runtime model too

disc.note: dark plate 0.8R, thin double outer ring (0.75R/0.71R) + inner ring 0.53R, emerald N 0.42R (#1FC98A, 0.9); disc squashed 1.7x in depth so the hero view matches the ref - other angles show an oval

swirl.note: additive emissive ribbons #2FD88F 0.5 + 36 sparks; built round RightHand_Anchor, 0.35 m behind the hand - re-anchor to the runtime hand bone

runtime_shaders: M_S01_DiscRing/M_S01_DiscLogo/M_S01_Strip/M_S01_CeilLip/M_S01_CeilPod/M_S01_Swirl/M_S01_Spark are additive (AdditiveBlending, depthWrite false); M_Window_City unlit; M_S01_Leaf uses vertex colour x1.8 + 0.9 self-glow
lighting: none exported; lit in three.js. Blender review look: Standard, Glare bloom; sun through the window (rot 78,0,205, energy 1.0), fill area 600 W from the camera, disc glow area 600 W above the disc (0.3,1.0,0.7), robot rim area 800 W; world 0.06,0.09,0.10 x1.5, no volume
html_overlay: nav, title, subtitle, 2 buttons and scroll cue are HTML over the right wall band x 0.62-0.95
open_notes: robot eyes are circuit shapes vs the ref's smile arcs (runtime face)
swirl is line ribbons vs the ref's soft particle haze - a runtime particle shader would match better
plants are low-poly leaf cards (fine under DOF)
plant_L zone sits at the gate edge (80.6%)

portrait_framing.note: At 9:19.5 portrait, robot x=-2.15 clips left at hero z=13; pulling back +5m (z=18, x=-0.8) frames robot and disc inside S01_window_city bounds.
